agents.guardrail: Never recommend lowering visual quality or removing gameplay systems as a first-line fix.

findings.message: No visual defect is confirmed from file counts or pixel differences alone. Synchronized captures remain available for human review; automated geometry checks use Babylon.js runtime evidence.

agents.guardrail: Do not change the art direction, materials, resolution or effects based only on a pixel-difference score.
Do not reposition, delete or rebuild world objects without object-level evidence and a regression capture.
Skipped phases are not passes. Missing test evidence never counts as a successful validation.

autonomy.note: This first unattended layer measures, classifies and assigns evidence-backed tasks. It does not write game source or publish unvalidated repairs.

limitations: GitHub Actions Chromium/SwiftShader is a cloud test environment, not the physical Galaxy S26 Ultra Adreno GPU.
No judgement of visual quality is inferred from screenshot counts or pixel differences alone.
Unavailable metrics remain unknown; they are never fabricated as zero.
The specialist rules are not LLM agents. A model-backed external agent requires a separately configured provider credential and an approved usage budget.
